name: Goddard Space Club Scholars Program
org: NASA Goddard Space Flight Center, Office of STEM Engagement

offerings.summary: A six-week in-person summer NASA experience for local 10th-12th graders at Goddard in Greenbelt or Wallops Flight Facility.

grades.raw: At time of application, enrolled in grade 10, 11, or 12 and in good standing; Must have completed Sophomore year (10th grade) in high school by the starting date of the program

age.raw: Must be 16 years of age by the starting date of the program

residency.anchor: NASA's Goddard Space Flight Center, Greenbelt, MD, or NASA's Wallops Flight Facility, Wallops Island, VA
residency.raw: Must live and maintain a permanent residence within commuting distance (50 miles) of NASA's Goddard Space Flight Center, Greenbelt, MD, or NASA's Wallops Flight Facility, Wallops Island, VA

sched.schedule_raw: six weeks, five days per week

deadlines.raw: The application deadline is April 17, 11:59 p.m. EST.

issues: Summer 2027 not announced; page states Summer 2026 positions are filled

evidence.quote: At time of application, enrolled in grade 10, 11, or 12 and in good standing; Must have completed Sophomore year (10th grade) in high school by the starting date of the program; Must be 16 years of age by the starting date of the program; Must be a U.S. citizen; Must live and maintain a permanent residence within commuting distance (50 miles) of NASA's Goddard Space Flight Center, Greenbelt, MD, or NASA's Wallops Flight Facility, Wallops Island, VA. Minimum 3.0 GPA (unweighted) on a 4.0 scale
All positions have been filled for Summer 2026. Please apply again next year.
